عَدَانَةٌ A company (AA, K, TA) of men: (AA, TA:) pl. عَدَانَاتٌ: (AA, K, TA:) or this latter signifies parties, or distinct bodies, of men: (S, TA:) and accord. to IAar رِجَالٌ عَدَانَاتٌ means men remaining, staying, dwelling, or abiding. (TA.) ＝
-A2- See also what next follows.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
